en.title: US Army Black Hawk nearly struck by fireworks during NFL flyover in Seattle
en.summary: A US Army UH-60M Black Hawk narrowly avoided fireworks during a pregame flyover at Lumen Field in Seattle, when pyrotechnics erupted while the final helicopter in a four-aircraft formation was still passing over the stadium.
body: On November 2, 2026, four US Army Sikorsky UH-60M Black Hawk helicopters from the 2-158th Assault Helicopter Battalion, part of the 16th Combat Aviation Brigade, performed a ceremonial flyover at Lumen Field in Seattle as part of the national anthem ceremony ahead of the Monday Night Football matchup between the Seattle Seahawks and the Chicago Bears, which attracted approximately 70,000 spectators. According to MyNorthwest, as cited in the report, the first three helicopters passed over the stadium before the fireworks display began, but the fourth aircraft was still nearby when the stadium's pyrotechnics were activated.

Video footage shared widely on social media shows fireworks launching from the stadium structure and exploding extremely close to the trailing helicopter, appearing from certain camera angles to pass alongside the aircraft's rear section. It remains unclear whether any projectile actually made contact, and the helicopter nevertheless continued its flight behind the other three helicopters, with no visible signs of damage. Neither an official explanation for the timing nor confirmation of an aircraft inspection was available in the initial reporting, and the incident raised questions about coordination between stadium personnel and military flight crews.

facts.claim: A US Army Black Hawk helicopter narrowly avoided fireworks during a pregame flyover at Lumen Field in Seattle on November 2, 2026, during the NFL game between the Seattle Seahawks and the Chicago Bears.

Four US Army Sikorsky UH-60M Black Hawk helicopters from the 2-158th Assault Helicopter Battalion, part of the 16th Combat Aviation Brigade, performed the flyover as part of the national anthem ceremony.
The first three helicopters passed over the stadium before the fireworks display began, while the fourth aircraft was still nearby when the stadium pyrotechnics were activated.
Video footage shows fireworks exploding extremely close to the trailing helicopter, and it remains unclear whether any projectile actually made contact.
The helicopter continued flying with no apparent damage reported, and neither an official explanation for the timing nor confirmation of an aircraft inspection was available in the initial reporting.
The flyover attracted approximately 70,000 spectators, and the incident raised questions about coordination between stadium personnel and military flight crews.

zh.title: 美軍黑鷹直升機NFL飛越表演險遭煙火擊中
zh.summary: 美軍4架UH-60M黑鷹直升機在西雅圖NFL賽前飛越表演時，最後一架直升機尚未完全飛離球場上空，球場煙火便已施放，煙火在直升機極近處爆炸，所幸未見明顯損傷。
body: 2026年11月2日，美國陸軍4架UH-60M黑鷹直升機在西雅圖流明球場舉行的西雅圖海鷹對芝加哥熊NFL賽前國歌儀式中執行飛越表演。這4架直升機隸屬第16戰鬥航空旅第2-158突擊直升機營，表演吸引約7萬名觀眾入場。前3架直升機飛越球場後，球場煙火才開始施放，但第4架直升機當時仍在球場附近，煙火在其極近處爆炸，現場觀眾發出驚呼。
社群流傳的影片顯示，煙火從球場結構發射並在尾隨直升機後段附近爆炸，從某些角度看來煙火似乎從機身旁掠過，但目前尚不清楚是否有任何投射物實際接觸機身。該直升機隨後繼續跟隨其他3架直升機飛行，未見明顯損傷；初步報導中也未有官方說明煙火施放時機，也未證實是否已對該機進行檢查。此事引發外界關注球場人員與軍方飛行組員之間的協調問題，因為直升機飛行速度較慢，在場館附近停留時間較長，飛越表演的時機協調格外重要。
